jurisdiction_name: GROVE CITY COUNCIL WARD 4 (GROVE CITY-CITY City)
narrative: Grove City Council Ward 4 (City of Grove City-city) has 7,245 registered voters, with 54.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 27.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 17.4%, a clear Republican lean of 10.3 percentage points.
